text: Amina understood that a wrong answer is worse than no answer for a clinic. The bot says 'call us' when unsure, which is exactly what we wanted.
Invoices that used to take a morning now take twenty minutes of checking. Clear explanations, good communication.
The per-customer explanations made the model usable for our retention team. Would hire again.
Good matching quality. Took a bit longer than planned because our ATS webhook was a mess, which was not her fault.
Forecasts land in our ordering sheet every evening. Simple and reliable.
Detector works well in good light. Night shift needed extra lamps; she flagged that early.
Our prompt changes finally have tests. Every PR now shows which summaries got worse and what it costs.
Recommendations beat 'most popular' in our test. Documentation could have been longer.
Explained every flag. Our analyst actually trusts it.
Prototype was solid and she was honest that it should not send emails on its own.
